scope: A1 schema/protocol/pure policy/query primitives and B1 core client only; read-only product review

findings.title: Redact transport logs for target knowledge reads
findings.repro_logic: Call getCollaborationKnowledgeTarget for a project or workspace with an opaque cursor and an HTTP 4xx/5xx JSON response whose error/message contains a private sentinel. The target URL does not match fetchRaw collaborationRequest/sourceIssueRequest, so request/response logs retain the cursor and the error logger emits the raw message before the knowledge wrapper receives the ApiError.
findings.impact: Private derived content from an error and opaque knowledge pagination data can enter persistent client/platform logs. The source knowledge routes already receive redacted logging; the target routes carry the same private projection.
findings.minimal_fix: Classify /api/projects/{id}/knowledge and /api/workspaces/{id}/knowledge as private for logging and query-string removal. Keep that privacy classification separate from the account-scoped collaboration flag so the captured X-Workspace-ID and cleared slug remain intact.
findings.verification_needed: Add target project/workspace logger-sentinel and cursor regressions for failed responses, with assertions that captured workspace headers are preserved.

findings.title: Allow the authorized content-free rejection of unavailable pending candidates
findings.repro_logic: A human with current source Read and target confirmer authority receives a source_unavailable pending candidate with can_reject=true, as now returned by KnowledgeCapabilitiesFor. The unavailable schema rejects that valid projection; even after parsing is aligned, prepareKnowledgeDecision rejects every candidate whose availability is not available.
findings.impact: The intended narrowing action is unavailable, and a valid source/target page containing that row becomes a protocol error. This is the already identified A2/main cross-layer mismatch, independently confirmed rather than a new issue.
findings.minimal_fix: Allow can_reject on source_unavailable pending rows and permit the decision preparer to reject those rows when the server grants can_reject. Keep restricted target-only rows unable to reject, keep approval gated on available material, and keep summary/body/hash/refs/quoted decision reason suppressed. Align api-seam.md.
findings.verification_needed: Add unavailable and expired pending rejection regressions plus restricted/no-capability denial and private-field suppression cases.
